claim: Section 1 Administrative Information with incident number etc.
quote: SECTION 1 - ADMINISTRATIVE INFORMATION

claim: Section 2 is Victim or Witness Identification with name, address, telephone, email
quote: SECTION 2 - CERTIFICATION OF NO VICTIM(S) OR WITNESS(ES) | SECTION 5 - LIST OF VICTIM(S) AND WITNESS(ES)
fix: Section 2 is the trial counsel certification of no victims or witnesses. Section 5 lists victims and witnesses with name, address, telephone and a Yes or No notify initial. The form has no email field.

claim: Section 3 is the Election with yes or no and events covered including mandatory supervised release, work release, furlough, expiration of sentence
quote: SECTION 3 - CERTIFICATION OF ADVICE TO VICTIM(S) AND WITNESS(ES)
fix: Section 3 certifies advice given to victims. The Yes or No election is initialed in Section 5 Column 4. The form lists transfer, parole hearings, release from confinement, escape and death. It does not list work release, furlough or expiration of sentence.

claim: Section 4 is Certification with signature blocks for victim or witness and trial counsel
quote: SECTION 4 - DISTRIBUTION | Signature of Trial Counsel or Designee
fix: Section 4 is Distribution to the Military Service Central Repository, law enforcement and the correctional facility. Only the trial counsel or designee signs. The victim or witness initials Section 5.
